# Lado Bridal

> Bridal hair and make-up by Quinty Kant, MUAH-certified bridal hairstylist and make-up artist based in Leeuwarden (Friesland, the Netherlands). Trial sessions in the studio in Leeuwarden; on-location wedding-day styling across Noord-Nederland, the rest of the Netherlands and abroad.

## Key facts
- 4 years of experience, 40+ brides styled, 5+ international weddings, 5.0 rating on Google
- Trial session (proefsessie) 4–8 weeks before the wedding; digital preparation possible for brides abroad
- Peak season (May–September) books up 9–12 months ahead
- Personal quote within 2 working days; booking confirmed with signature + 25% deposit
- Complete Bruidslook (hair + make-up, incl. trial and styling guide): from €600
- Bridesmaid/guest €75 per person (hair or make-up); mother of the bride €75 incl. styling advice; extra lashes €15; photoshoot from €175 per look; extra touch-up hour €65
- Travel: €0.35/km from Leeuwarden, return; accommodation added beyond 75 km one way
- Destinations: Italy, Spain, France, Portugal, Austria, Greece, Belgium, Germany
